decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
description: Demolition of existing rear extension and erection of single storey side and rear extension to dwellinghouse.
